verdict.rationale: SolidJS's own docs state directly that only code depending on a changed piece of state reruns. They also document automatic dependency tracking and a render-once component model, with built-in stores (solid-gh-1, solid-gh-2, solid-gh-9, solid-gh-10, solid-gh-14). Hands-on community reports corroborate the fine-grained reactive updates and granular computed values (solid-comm-7, solid-comm-10, solid-comm-19), while the complaints about API intuitiveness and functions-as-props describe ergonomics, not a failure of the capability. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of the reactive primitives (signals, effects, memos) beyond README-level summary claims.
